description: This file defines the 'cave_map_generator' class responsible for generating cave maps, chambers, and passages for the Wesnoth game, including map creation, chamber placement, and pathfinding logic.

classes.name: cave_map_generator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating cave maps with chambers and passages, including configuration and terrain placement.

classes.name: passage_path_calculator
classes.description: A helper class implementing cost calculation for pathfinding through passages, considering terrain and windiness.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::create_map
methods.description: Creates a map based on configuration arguments and returns the map data as a string.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::create_scenario
methods.description: Generates the cave scenario including chambers and passages, returning a config object with map data.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::build_chamber
methods.description: Recursively builds a chamber area on the map.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::generate_chambers
methods.description: Generates chambers based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::place_chamber
methods.description: Places a chamber's terrain and items on the map.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::place_items
methods.description: Places items within a chamber at specified locations.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::place_passage
methods.description: Creates a passage between two locations using pathfinding.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::set_terrain
methods.description: Sets terrain type at a specific location, with village density consideration.

methods.name: cave_map_generator::place_castle
methods.description: Places a castle terrain at a location and its adjacent tiles.

methods.name: passage_path_calculator::cost
methods.description: Calculates movement cost for pathfinding, considering terrain and windiness.
